## VNPAY

**Type**: payment | **Criticality**: high | **Direction**: bidirectional

### Authentication

TmnCode (merchant terminal code) + hash secret (HMAC used for request signature and IPN signature validation). Stored in payment module config. **[BLOCK]** never log the hash secret.

### Endpoints

#### GET/POST VNPAY Pay (redirect)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Purpose** | Redirect customer from Magento checkout to VNPAY hosted payment page. Implemented by `Vnpayment\VNPAY\Controller\Order\Pay`. |
| **Request format** | HTTP query string: `tmnCode`, `amount`, `orderId`, `orderInfo`, `returnUrl`, `vnp_SecureHash` (signature over sorted params) |
| **Response format** | VNPAY hosted payment page (HTML); customer completes payment |
| **Rate limit** | Not documented |
| **Error handling** | [TBD — verify error/decline handling in module code] |
| **Notes** | Default `active=0` in config.xml — must be enabled + configured for VN market before go-live. |

#### GET/POST Order/Info (return URL)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Purpose** | Customer return landing after VNPAY payment. Implemented by `Vnpayment\VNPAY\Controller\Order\Info`. |
| **Request format** | HTTP query params from VNPAY (response signature included) |
| **Response format** | Magento checkout success / failure redirect |
| **Rate limit** | Not documented |
| **Error handling** | [TBD] |
| **Notes** | Must validate response signature before trusting status shown to customer. |

#### GET/POST Order/Ipn (server-to-server IPN)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Purpose** | VNPAY server-to-server payment notification. Implemented by `Vnpayment\VNPAY\Controller\Order\Ipn`. |
| **Request format** | HTTP query params: transaction status, amount, orderId, `vnp_SecureHash` |
| **Response format** | HTTP 200 ack (idempotent) |
| **Rate limit** | Not documented |
| **Error handling** | **[BLOCK]** must be idempotent via unique event/transaction id; reject duplicate processing on retry. Re-validate signature server-side. |
| **Notes** | HIGH-RISK: signature validation + idempotency. Any change requires SA review (Tier 2). |

### Webhooks

| Event | Endpoint | Action |
|-------|----------|--------|
| Payment notification (IPN) | `vnpay/order/ipn` (Controller/Order/Ipn) | Validate signature → idempotently update order state (capture/decline) |

## Mollie Payments

**Type**: payment | **Criticality**: high | **Direction**: bidirectional

### Authentication

API key + webhook (managed by composer module `mollie/magento2` 3.1.1 + Hyvä compat bundle `mollie/magento2-hyva-compatibility` 3.1.0). API key stored in Mollie store config.

### Endpoints

#### Mollie Orders/Payments API

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Purpose** | Create Mollie order/payment, redirect/inline checkout, capture. Managed entirely by the Mollie Magento2 module. |
| **Request format** | REST/HTTPS per Mollie API (module-owned) |
| **Response format** | Mollie API JSON |
| **Rate limit** | Per Mollie account |
| **Error handling** | Module-owned; verify via module config + logs |
| **Notes** | Active payment method. Do not hand-roll — use the module's payment method models. |

### Webhooks

| Event | Endpoint | Action |
|-------|----------|--------|
| Payment status update | Mollie webhook route (module-owned) | Module updates order state from Mollie status |

## Mageplaza TableRate Shipping

**Type**: shipping | **Criticality**: medium | **Direction**: outbound

### Authentication

n/a (internal Magento carrier).

### Endpoints

No external API. Internal carrier model (`mptablerate`) computes rates from a table-rate matrix using dimensional attributes (length/width/height) with shipping factor 5000.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Purpose** | Volume/weight-based shipping rate calculation at cart/checkout. |
| **Request format** | Quote item + product dimensional attributes (L/W/H), destination |
| **Response format** | Shipping rate(s) injected into quote |
| **Rate limit** | n/a |
| **Error handling** | Falls back to no rate if no table match |
| **Notes** | Carrier code `mptablerate`, default inactive. Dimensional factor 5000. |

## TikTok Events API (Secomm_Tracking)

- **Endpoint:** `POST https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/event/boost/` (adapter: `Secomm\Tracking\Model\Vendor\TikTokEventsAdapter`)
- **Auth:** header `Access-Token` (encrypted `secomm_tracking/tiktok/access_token`)
- **Payload要点:** `event_source=web`, `event_source_id={pixel}`, `data[].event` (CompletePayment cho purchase; Refund custom), `event_id` shared browser/server, `user.{email,phone,external_id}` SHA-256 hex, `properties.{currency,value,order_id,contents}`; `is_debug_event` khi Test Mode.
- **Response:** `code=0` OK; `code 401xx` auth/pixel errors fail-fast (no retry); others retry.
